messages:
Samir (AE): FYI — AcmeHealth wants a bundled proposal: API (200M tokens/mo commit), Redwood Optimize (quality + cost tooling), and Console add-on (extended retention + seat-based admin). They're pushing for a single discounted SKU across products. Asked for 35% off list.
Maria (SE): Thanks. Do we have customer size/ARR? Also they want a 2-week POC with dedicated capacity and private VPC for the demo.
Samir (AE): Estimated ARR ~ $450k/yr on a 12mo commit. POC is gating procurement — security/Q checklist must be done. They prefer on-prem/pricing tied to committed throughput.
Claire (RevOps): Heads up: 35% off across API + Optimize + Console is above our standard cross-product caps for that commit. Our baseline table: 20% typical for this band, +5% for multi-year, +5% for strategic enterprise. Need deal desk approval for anything >30%.
Eli (Deal Desk): @Claire correct. If they're doing Dedicated + Private, that's enterprise package; we can route to exception committee. Need a clear SKU mapping and whether POC credit converts to invoice. Provide a rate-card calc.
Maria (SE): I'll map SKUs. Preliminary pricing calc:
```
API_committed_200M: $0.0009/token -> est $180k/yr
Optimize_addon: $80k/yr (usage & seats)
Console_enterprise: $40k/yr (retention + seats)
List_total: $300k/yr
Requested 35% -> $195k/yr
```
They asked if POC (2 weeks) can be free or convert to credits against committed spend.
Claire (RevOps): We normally offer a $15k POC credit for deals >= $250k ARR, applies if signed. If they need isolated Dedicated for the POC we charge for reserved infra day rate unless SE supports as demo. Need explicit statement in SOW.
Juno (Security): Security team flagged: AcmeHealth requires SOC2 + HIPAA attestation, customer wants KMS/HSM for keys, and an ATO questionnaire answered. Also data residency in eu-west-1 for some PHI workflows. We'll need to confirm Redwood Private package covers those controls.
Samir (AE): Can we include Private deployment + KMS as add-on in the quote? They insisted on it. Also they want the Console retention to be 13 months (not standard 12) and anonymization on logs.
Maria (SE): Private + KMS is fine but changes pricing. For Dedicated we need a baseline commit that covers GPU pool sizing. POC requires a scaled-down dedicated pool (N=2 gpus) for 2 weeks. I'll open an infra request. deploy-bot: POC env request created (req-8742).
deploy-bot: POC env req-8742 -> provisioning started. ETA 36h.
Eli (Deal Desk): For discount ask: prepare this for exception review. We need: final SKU list, proof of ARR/exec sponsor, security appendix signoff, and whether POC credit will be applied to committed spend. If yes, margin impact calc.
Claire (RevOps): I'll run margin impact. Quick question: does Optimize billing ratchet with token usage? If they under-use planned tokens we need shortfall protection or reconciled true-ups.
Maria (SE): Optimize is usage-based but we can include a committed credit profile for the POC/first quarter. Recommend a true-up clause at quarter end. I'll draft language.
Samir (AE): Customer also asked for a 45-day invoice instead of standard 30 and a 10% SLA rebate if latency > X ms (they're sensitive). That might trigger legal review.
Eli (Deal Desk): 45-day payment terms OK to consider if ARR and security cleared. SLA rebate needs specific SLOs and product signoff — legal will want a cap (e.g., 5% of invoice).
Juno (Security): I'll start the security questionnaire response. Send me the completed SOC2 artifact and KMS config. Also confirm which data planes live in eu-west-1.
Samir (AE): I'll get signer (Acme Health: legal contact is "N. Patel"). Next steps I propose: 1) Maria to finalize SKU & POC infra spec; 2) Juno to start questionnaire; 3) Claire to produce margin & model with both 30% and 35% concession scenarios; 4) Eli to schedule deal-desk exception review if >30%.
Maria (SE): On it. Will post SKU breakdown and a short quote doc in this thread by EOD PST.
Claire (RevOps): I'll try to get margin calc and draft exception memo by tomorrow morning.
Eli (Deal Desk): If you can include a recommended concession (e.g., grant 30% now, 5% contingent on annual renewal and case study) that's easier to get approved.
Samir (AE): Nice — suggest: 30% committed discount + 5% renewal/CS conditional. I'll pitch that.
Juno (Security): Also propose redaction/anonymization checklist for logs in SOW. I'll attach soon.
Samir (AE): Great — thanks team. Will update AcmeHealth that we're compiling final quote + POC plan.
Maria (SE): Quick note: link to rate card tooling for reference: https://internal.redwood/rev/ratecard (SEs only).
Claire (RevOps): Also pinging @Eli for exception calendar — Eli can you block 30m tomorrow 09:30 PT?
Eli (Deal Desk): Blocked.
Samir (AE): Closing loop: will post customer's contract timeline once I hear from legal.
Maria (SE): Uploading SKU spreadsheet now -> https://internal.redwood/dl/sku-acme-1767001234.csv
Juno (Security): Uploaded initial sec questionnaire answers -> https://internal.redwood/dl/sec-q-acme-1767001234.pdf
Claire (RevOps): Margin model uploaded -> https://internal.redwood/dl/margin-acme-1767001234.xlsx :eyes:
Samir (AE): Thanks all. Will follow up after the deal-desk. :thumbsup:
